lines.text: You remember one word from a task you made last month. Just the word migration. That is all you have.
Two hundred tasks, five workspaces. Scrolling means opening each one and squinting at titles.
Press Command K, or Control K on Windows. A search box opens over whatever you are doing.
Type your one word. It searches titles and descriptions, so a single remembered word is enough.
The search runs straight from your device, with no round trip to a server, so it feels instant.
Results appear as you type, and the list narrows with every letter you add.
Arrow down to the one you want, and press enter. The task opens right where you left off.
Each result carries its status, so you can tell a finished task from one still running at a glance.
Even a word buried in the description counts, so the detail you wrote last month is findable.
Every old task is one keystroke away. Nothing you filed ever gets lost in the scroll.
Press escape, and you are straight back to what you were doing.
What is the oldest task you wish you could find right now? Search it at Agent R Q dot com.
